audit_drops.reason: su01 twin: plug 'stopped responding' plus refund request; R3 gives refunds to Billing and faults to Tech Tier 1 with no order between general queues, so Billing and Tier 1 are both defensible (solver flagged 0.75).

su05: Ombudsman mention (R2 Legal Liaison) vs damage during engineer visit (R6 local addendum Field Service). The rules set no precedence between R2 and R6 (unlike R7/R8, which state theirs); gold card asserts 'specialist queues come ahead of the local addendum', which the card never says. Underspecified.

hr07 twin: gold record_only is wrong. AT2 counts absences in ANY rolling six months; 23 January, 14 April and 20 July all fall within 23 Jan-22 Jul (under six months), so an attendance review is triggered. The twin also leaves the contradicting header 'window starts 1 February' above a 23 January absence.

so04 base: an encoded PowerShell command 'blocked by application control' with no confirmed compromise can be read as Sev4 'blocked attempts' (the card's own close_with_note_sev4 line) or as Sev3 'suspicious activity'. Two readings are defensible (solver 0.70).
so04 twin: the same Sev3/Sev4 ambiguity as r_120 (hold_for_morning_l1 vs close_with_note_sev4).

co04: 'Your tender process stinks' is an expression of dissatisfaction (IR3 complaint), and IR4 says that when a request is both, both processes run; a single-team answer is underspecified (FOI vs Stage 1).
